data.title: BTC News: $7B Bitcoin Options Expiry Aftermath – What Happens Next?
data.description: Bitcoin barely reacted after $7 billion in Deribit options expired; in contrast, BTC is now trading at $61,700 with a modest daily recovery following the news. The market had spent days bracing for the settlement, but the biggest derivatives event of the week came and went without a major price ...
